# Planned workflows

The initial workflows will be added with the first functional site adapters:

1. Validate source metadata and links on pull requests.
2. Build every supported renderer.
3. Assemble static outputs beneath their public subpaths.
4. Deploy one GitHub Pages artifact from the default branch.

Redocly and Mintlify may use their native hosted deployments if their static
outputs cannot be included cleanly in the common artifact.
